subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Frank said to Albert, “ How is your search for a new house coming along?”

options.text: Frank asked Albert how his search for a new house was coming along.
Frank asked Albert how was your search for a new house coming along.
Frank asked Albert how is your search for a new house coming along.
Frank wanted to know how was Albert’s search for a new house coming along.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Frank asked Albert how his search for a new house was coming along.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Present Continuous Tense.
 
• Present Continuous Tense changes to Past Continuous Tense.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed in asked, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the question mark in the sentence of Indirect speech.
 
• The question is changed to assertive form and is simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
 
• Example: *John said to Ravi, "How are you buying a camera?" *(Direct speech)
 
 
 
 

 * John asked Ravi how he was buying a camera.* (Indirect speech)

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Frank asked Albert how his search for a new house was coming along.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

__
 
• If the sentence of Direct speech has a question that cannot be answered by saying yes or no then it does not uses “if” or “whether” in its Indirect speech.

 
 
• Example: * **She said to me, “Where did you buy this dress from?” *(Direct speech)

 * **She asked me where I had bought that dress from. *(Indirect speech)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• Direct Speech को Indirect Speech में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Continuous Tense में है।
 
• Present Continuous Tense, Past Continuous Tense में बदल जाता है
 
• Commas और inverted commas हटा दे।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में that प्रयोग न करें।
 
• Said/said to रिपोर्टिंग verb वाक्य की प्रकृति के अनुसार asked, demanded, ordered, enquired में बदल जाती है।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में प्रश्न चिह्न हटा दें।
 
• Question को assertive form में बदल दिया जाता है और केवल reporting verb के बाद रखा जाता है।
 
 
• Example: *John said to Ravi, "How are you buying a camera?" *(Direct speech)
 
 
 
 

* John asked Ravi how he was buying a camera.* (Indirect speech)
